name: Dragon Den - Killfeed
teaser: Adds an on-screen killfeed showing attacker, victim, weapon, ammo, body part, and distance. Includes faction icons and full customization options.
description_html:
Features and Usage

Features

  • Killfeed showing every kill in a corner
  • Displays attacker, victim, weapon, ammo type, body part and distance
  • Includes faction icons for USEC, BEAR, Scav, and Unknown
  • Customizable layout: choose top/bottom left/right corner
  • Adjustable margins, font size, color, and spacing between lines
  • Configurable display duration and fade-out speed for each kill
  • Set max number of killfeed lines (if shown more than max, it removes oldest ones)
  • Option to include or hide kills from other players and bots
  • Text format using tokens: {attacker}, {victim}, {bp}, {weapon}, {ammo}, {dist}
  • Adjustable faction icon tint and toggle for visibility
  • Semi-transparent background for readability
  • All settings configurable directly through BepInEx menu
Installation

Unpack the zip and drop the user folder into your SPTarkov root.

What is Dragon Den

Dragon Den is my twist on Tarkov. It’s where cuteness, edgyness, and weirdness all collide, while still keeping things believable.

  • Traders with their own quirks and attitude
  • Custom items and quests that feel fresh
  • Backpacks, armor, facewear and headwear with personality
  • Odd creations that shouldn’t exist… but somehow fit right in

No weapons, just everything else that makes Tarkov less boring.
